track: DG1 selective consolidation / non-token causal memory
hypothesis: A bounded three-bank causal version-space with contradiction-gated cold retrieval retains earlier causal context after A→B→C→A or A→B→C→B interference with fewer confident errors and more unseen-correct predictions than independently implemented three-bank conventional filters and the frozen two-bank substrate.

ABCD_OOD.phase_steps: A, B, C, D; D effect is (state==15) xor action sign; out of 40-rule grammar

world_and_actions: 4-bit physical state, 4 binary-effect physical actions. Regimes A/B/C independently sample one of the unchanged 40 affine/3-bit-majority causal rules per action from deterministic Python Random(seed*131 + phase*719 + action*47); ensure all 3 distinct for each action by fixed deterministic increment on any collision. Outcome state xor (effect << action). Exactly 80 physical steps/world, one shared state trajectory for all arms, deterministic actions (seed+step)%4 except paid exogenous flips at [6,14,22,30,38,46,54,62,70,78] bit (seed//7+step//8)%4. 10 flips not fitted; 70 real causal observations. Initial state seed%16; no evaluator resets or hidden phase input.
arms: cold_three_bank: three 40-rule masks/action bank slots; contradiction-gated context reactivation, bounded real-event replay only at public eight-step rest; conservative prediction after two independent post-switch consistent events
cold_three_bank_no_gate: identical algorithm, replay and capacity without conservative confidence gate
three_bank_forgetful_fifo: same algorithm and capacity but evicts least recently used bank when all 3 occupied
conventional_three_bank_hmm: independently coded three-state Bayesian-style hazard/change-filter with three bank version spaces and three explicit posterior weights
conventional_three_bank_replay: conventional HMM plus bounded eight-event public replay at same rest boundaries
frozen_sl04_two_bank: unmodified SL04 version-space selective sleep control, imported from pinned parent
frozen_sl04_recent: unmodified SL04 conventional recent-window control
cold_retention: At physical step 60, serialize each learner, integrity check and cold restore before continuing to step 80; final result must equal uninterrupted digest-based reference on the same observations. Tamper, snapshot type, truncated and capacity-limit negative tests. Snapshot max 8192 bytes; physical event window max 48 actual causal tuples; three new banks * four actions * 40 rule hypotheses=480 logical rule bits, plus disclosed metadata; old two-bank controls retain original capacity. Report snapshot bytes and per-arm whole inference/update ns; capacity and CPU NOT claimed exact matched.
prediction: Use only actually witnessed charged causal state/action/effect observations. Never fit to dream, synthetic counterfactuals, evaluator 64-pair audits, hidden regime identity, world generator or seed. If context ambiguous, abstain. No token or gradient learning.
measurement: Prequential prediction on every paid causal action plus hidden-regime evaluator-only exhaustive 64-pair audits after steps 20,40,60,80 and novel unseen state/action subset not physically observed. Inspect final-phase A/B cold retention, stationary performance, out-of-grammar confident errors, stagewise conflicting outcomes and cold-restored equivalence. 8 seeds per cohort x 64 queries=512 audit queries/cohort. Preserve all negative outcomes.

frozen_primary.classification: DEV_SIGNAL_NOT_SCIENCE if ALL primary thresholds pass; MIXED_DEV if retained-context coverage improves vs both conventional baselines but error/cost controls fail; NEGATIVE_DEV otherwise. INVALID on evidence leakage, unbounded memory, unequal physical actions, changed seeds/thresholds or unverified source/provenance.
